'''OTSD Sealed''' is a sealed deck format in the [[Players Committee]]'s ''Alternate Format Tournament Guide'' (revised September 2015). Each player opens one [[Official Tournament Sealed Deck]] (OTSD) and builds a deck from it.<ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' sealed deck
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee (Alternate Format Tournament Guide, 2015)
* '''Card pool:''' one Official Tournament Sealed Deck per player
* '''In use:''' listed in 2015; events not recorded
* '''GEMP:''' none

== Card pool ==
Each player needs one Official Tournament Sealed Deck. The format uses the guide's '''Sealed''' rules:<ref name="afg" />
* Product stays unopened until each player is paired with a first opponent and assigned a side of the Force for the whole tournament.
* Both players open everything at the same time and swap, face down, all cards of the other side of the Force. Each player keeps the cards received.
* If a player has no opponent, the Tournament Director swaps with that player from an extra sealed deck.
* Deck building time is 10 minutes for 40-card decks and 20 minutes for 60-card decks. Between games a player may re-customize the deck from the original stock of sealed cards, but may not add cards from outside or trade.

The guide does not give a deck size for this format. Sealed deck games are timed at one minute per card in the deck. A tournament has at least three games and a Final Confrontation between the top Light Side and top Dark Side players, timed at 1.5 times the normal game length.<ref name="afg" />

== History ==
The same product is the basis of [[OTSD Booster Draft]], in which the boosters are drafted instead of swapped.<ref name="afg" /> No event in OTSD Sealed is recorded on this wiki.
